title: Nimbus Pipeline
subtitle: Tell the pipeline how to behave. Nothing runs until you say so.

steps.title: The basics
steps.subtitle: Name your pipeline and say where it will live.

fields.label: Project name
fields.help: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Shows up in logs and file names.
fields.patternMsg: Use 2–31 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes.

fields.label: What does it do?
fields.help: Optional. A sentence for your future self.
fields.placeholder: Copies new orders into the warehouse every night…

fields.label: Environment
fields.help: Production turns on safety checks and stricter retries.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Pick the region closest to your data.

steps.title: Data source
steps.subtitle: Where does the data come from?

fields.label: Source type
fields.help: The system the pipeline reads from.

fields.label: Connection address
fields.help: Where to connect. Include the scheme, like postgres:// or https://.
fields.patternMsg: Start with a scheme, e.g. https://

fields.label: Access secret
fields.help: Optional for public sources. Stored in the config file as plain text.

fields.label: Encrypt the connection
fields.help: Uses TLS. Turn off only for local testing.

fields.label: Check for new data every
fields.help: Lower is fresher, higher is gentler on the source.

steps.title: Processing
steps.subtitle: How hard should the pipeline work, and what should it do to the data?

fields.label: Parallel workers
fields.help: Each worker handles one batch at a time. More workers finish faster and use more memory.

fields.label: Records per batch
fields.help: Bigger batches are efficient but slower to retry.

fields.label: Cleanup steps
fields.help: Pick any number. They run in the order shown.

fields.label: Compression
fields.help: Applies to everything written out.

steps.title: Output
steps.subtitle: What should the finished data look like, and where does it go?

fields.label: Destination folder
fields.help: Where result files are written.

fields.label: Labels
fields.help: Type a label and press Enter. Handy for filtering later.

fields.label: Start from
fields.help: Ignore anything older than this day. Leave empty to include everything.

fields.label: Label color
fields.help: Used to color this pipeline in dashboards.

steps.title: Monitoring
steps.subtitle: How loudly should the pipeline talk, and who hears about problems?

fields.label: Log detail
fields.help: Debug shows everything. Error shows only failures.

fields.label: Publish metrics
fields.help: Exposes health numbers for dashboards.

fields.label: Alert email
fields.help: Who to tell when something breaks.
fields.patternMsg: Enter a valid email, like you@company.com

fields.label: I understand this pipeline will read and write real data
fields.help: Required before you can launch.
